literal_meaning: শিঙায় ফুৎকার দেওয়া (blowing into a horn)
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনের অনিশ্চয়তা মনে রেখে বাঁচো, কবে শিঙে ফোঁকা হয়ে যাবে কে জানে।
তার হঠাৎ মৃত্যুতে সবাই শিঙে ফোঁকা বলে মনে করল।
example_sentences_in_english: Live with the uncertainty of life in mind; who knows when one might blow the horn and go.
His sudden death made everyone think he had blown the horn unexpectedly.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali folklore, symbolizing the unpredictable call of death like a sudden horn blast in village life.
note: The idiom emphasizes life's unpredictability, often used in reflective or cautionary contexts in Bengali culture.
